newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The cabinet on Monday approved a proposal for waiving overdue agricultural loans.

Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party on Monday began a month-long agitation to protest what it said wrong policies of the Awami League government that aggravated the law and order situation and weakened the economy.
The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) will provide $26 million as grant assistance to Bangladesh for projects to strengthen the democratic process and institutions.
India has told Bangladesh that it would back Dhaka in obtaining the membership of the Indian Ocean Rim Association for Regional Cooperation (IORRC).
Five major foreign companies have formed a consortium for a massive investment to build a new port near the Chittagong sea port.
The government has no plan to establish diplomatic ties with Israel, foreign minister Abdus Samad Azad told parliament on Monday during question hour.
The employers' organisations in South Asia have decided to launch a regional forum to create a basis for cooperation.
A modern cattle feed plant based on molasses will be set up shortly at Tongi near Dhaka.
